derivation.pan_speed: lerp(Tactical_Min_Scroll_Speed, Tactical_Max_Scroll_Speed) on the normalised distance; derived, pending timed original measurement
derivation.pitch_no_spline: below Pitch_Zoom_Begin_Fraction blend Pitch_When_Zoomed_In to Pitch_Default, otherwise Pitch_Default + Pitch_Per_Zoom_Unit * (t - max(begin, 0)), clamped to [Pitch_Min, Pitch_Max]
derivation.pitch_spline: Use_Splines=yes evaluates Pitch_Spline piecewise-linearly and supersedes Pitch_Min/Pitch_Max; derived, pending original capture
derivation.spline_format: flat numeric sequence read two at a time as (zoom fraction, value); ',' and ' ' separators are interchangeable
derivation.zoom_parameter: t in [0,1]; 0 is fully zoomed in (Distance_Min) and 1 is fully zoomed out (Distance_Max)
